decision: Proceed with the requested external 2.5D/3D reconstruction. The facade photograph and satellite view show the overall compound footprint and repeated residential elevations, but not survey dimensions or every concealed facade.
sourceImage: CampusOS_Codex_完整设计文档_v2/assets/source_maps/广外地图/友苑.png
acceptedLimits: Seven facade bands and approximately 21 m total height are visual estimates, not verified OSM building levels or measured height.
Satellite imagery informs display-only court landscaping; it does not alter GIS polygons, interior routes, or entrance facts.
The model uses the existing osm-way-313039031 footprint as one connected compound and does not invent subdivided place IDs.
